# Scan-scope registry is SHARED with sdk/openai, never re-derived: one s1 registration binds all
#: Refusal for a path that escapes the backend's root; only the model's own path is echoed.
# DeepAgents' filesystem middleware is rooted at cwd; refuse a broader writable_paths scope.
# ls shows only dirs holding in-scope files: an excluded file's NAME must not leak
#: Refusal a detection session's backend returns for any write-class operation.
# Middleware writes (eviction/offload) bypass permissions into the scanned repo; failing = no-op
# noqa: ARG002
# noqa: ARG002
# noqa: ARG002
# noqa: ARG002 — upstream signature
# Tilde checked on the ORIGINAL key: vpath is always "/"-prefixed by now, so
# vpath.startswith("~") can never fire.
# Root jail NOT enough (.git/config, security-scan/); choke point scopes all reads, pre-s1 too
# Resolution failures return None: the scope check must never REPLACE the jail's refusals
# Scope check BEFORE super()'s existence check, so it is never an existence oracle
# Only a named excluded FILE is refused; dirs fall through or every subtree is refused
# Match paths are virtual ("/rel/posix") on this always-virtual backend.
# .vvaharness/skills post-dates s1's walk; without this exemption every scan loads zero skills
# execute ignores routing; a non-empty routes map is the ONLY way past the NotImplementedError
#: Refusal for a write into repository metadata, whatever the permission globs allowed.
# The async variants delegate to these via asyncio.to_thread, so this covers both.
# Always disk-backed: native read_file/grep/glob are the only read path; StateBackend is empty.
# Opt-in per site, keyed off the SAME permitted_tool_calls as the gate, so the two cannot drift
# One-shot = detection parser: fail closed, since a tool-less turn cannot recover an eviction
# Frozen S10/S11 streaming: same read reach and write access as stock FilesystemBackend.
